name: Regional tracked map with logit routing (Nynxz)
plain: Keeps a region map that can move with the content during sampling, by reclustering canvas key features at a few middle blocks. It sends each canvas token to its region's own copy of the prompt with a logit bias. Mixing by log weight means that identical copies read as the one prompt. An optional isolation bias also pushes regions apart, and the code's notes warn it costs shared lighting.
math:
weight_r(i) = claim_r(i)·scale. bias(i, copy_r) = log(max(weight_r, 1e-4)) + log(influence_r if weight_r>1e-4).
bias(i, plain prompt) = log(max(1 − Σ weight_r, 1e-4)). Copies only read themselves and the image; everyone else −1e4 for the copies.
Isolation: bias(i,j) = −iso·(1 − share(i)·share(j)), share = claims normalised over regions, canvas rows only.
Map: at blocks around route_at, refine from k features, blend with the anchor mask by track, then blur.

props.hook: set_model_post_input patch + attn1 patch returning an attn_mask bias
props.architectures: Single-stream DiT with img_ids and txt_ids (Z-Image and Krea modules exist); bias is quadratic in sequence length

providers.author: Nynxz
providers.note: _patches.py read in full. _track, _lock, _lora, _zimage, _text were not read, so refinement itself is described only from call sites.

label: from code
surprise: Biases add to any incoming attn_mask rather than replacing it, so it can stack with another pack's logit bias.
